name: motherlode-code-small-en-v0.1
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (config.json max_position_embeddings 512). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (BERT), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A distillation of BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.033 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence other, repo created 2026-09-27. CAVEATS: Distilled from a d1 parent on bge-small-en-v1.5; card labels licence BUSL-1.1 (license_name: busl-1.1), which restricts commercial use despite the base being MIT. The SWE-bench number is a retrieval recall@1 over 411 contamination-checked instances, printed as counts (178 vs 145); the percentage in this record is derived from those counts, not printed. Card discloses two losses: COCO caption recall@1 0.3523 vs 0.3556 and one vision head.
